title: Shape Correction
summary: AZZ Precoat Metals provides coil coating shape correction to improve flatness, dimensional consistency, and downstream manufacturing.
body_markdown:
## Improved flatness and consistency for efficient downstream processing


AZZ Precoat Metals provides precision coil coating shape correction designed to improve flatness, dimensional consistency, and downstream manufacturing across coated steel and aluminum applications.


Coil coating shape correction addresses common flatness and surface conditions that can impact fabrication efficiency, product appearance, and overall performance. Through controlled metal leveling, straightening, and adjustment processes, metal coils are brought within precise dimensional tolerances to support smoother downstream processing and more consistent finished products.


#### **Proper coil coating shape correction helps improve:**


- Material flatness and stability
- Dimensional consistency
- Downstream fabrication performance
- Product appearance quality
- Manufacturing efficiency
- Overall processing reliability


By improving coil consistency before fabrication, customers can reduce production disruptions, improve forming performance, and maintain more efficient production workflows. As part of AZZ Precoat Metals’ integrated coil coating and processing capabilities, shape correction helps improve material consistency, production efficiency, and downstream fabrication performance.
